cases.description: A synthetic air-temperature instrument has an internally consistent capability, calibration, installation, sample and uncertainty record.
Capability is vendor-declared only; no independent characterization is present.
Accuracy source is only a provider assertion.
Capability range unit disagrees with the channel measurand unit.
Capability minimum is not below its maximum.
The sample value exceeds the capability range.
The calibration certificate is expired.
The calibration certificate cannot be authenticated.
The laboratory accreditation scope does not cover this method/range.
The calibration certificate references a different measurand.
The sample lies outside the calibration range.
As-found calibration is out of tolerance and prior-data impact has not been reviewed.
Installation record is unknown.
The instrument has been relocated without re-verification.
The installation geometry revision differs from the purpose profile.
The physical serial identity was reused after a replacement.
Instrument, calibration and sample firmware revisions do not match.
Sample unit differs from the channel profile.
Timestamp values are expressed in milliseconds but interpreted as seconds.
Timezone identity is absent.
Clock synchronization uncertainty exceeds the declared purpose limit.
Sample is saturated at a plausible maximum.
Sensor reports a device fault.
The sample is still in warm-up and is not yet valid.
Missing sample data is encoded as numeric zero.
A derived mean-radiant temperature record lacks its derivation method identity.
A derived channel is incorrectly labelled as raw processing.
A derived sample has no digest for its source measurements.
Uncertainty budget is incomplete.
Expanded uncertainty exceeds the declared measurement-purpose limit.
Uncertainty correlation model is missing.
The channel is a proposed v0.2 measurand, not admitted in v0.1.
CO2 concentration is promoted to a universal indoor-air-quality claim.
Electrical energy is derived from power but raw source intervals are absent.
Data-use rights for the observation have been revoked.
All synthetic gates satisfy a declared measurement purpose, but the result is only eligible for independent admission review.
